events.event: Bareskrim's Dittipidsiber (Brigjen Suhermanto) names Irjen Slamet Uliandi (SU) a fourth suspect in the illegal wiretapping case involving the President's phone, says he is not detained because he is recovering from a stroke, and says Listyo Sigit Prabowo and two other generals are detained at Mako Brimob.
events.key_numbers: 4 suspects · 3 detained at Rutan Mako Brimob · 1 not detained (post-stroke) · Charges: Pasal 258 KUHP, Pasal 332(1)(2) KUHP and/or Pasal 32(1) UU ITE · Police say Irjen Ahrie Sonta asked SU in Oct 2026 for permission to delete wiretap files and SU approved · SU was Bareskrim Monitoring head 2010-2019, now Dewan Pembina of its Monitoring Center
events.why_it_matters: The case moves from three to four suspects and police now describe a chain of approval for deleting wiretap files, so how far it goes is the open question.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered same evening by Antara, CNN Indonesia, detik, CNBC, Kompas.id, Tirto, Suara; headline cluster on detik section page

events.event: Former President Jokowi testifies as a prosecution witness at the East Jakarta District Court in Roy Suryo's defamation/ITE trial over the diploma allegations; per detik, Roy Suryo and dr Tifa reject his testimony and shake hands with him after the hearing.
events.key_numbers: About 1,000 supporters outside the court · Roy Suryo charged under Pasal 433(1) jo 441(1) UU 1/2023 (primary) and UU ITE Pasal 35 jo 51(1) (subsidiary) · Indictment read 17 Sep 2026 · Jokowi arrived about 08:30 WIB with Kaesang Pangarep
events.why_it_matters: An ex-president giving sworn testimony in an open trial on a long-running diploma dispute; the defence rejects his account.
events.spreading_evidence: Top block of detik news page (about 9 headlines); CNN, Kompas, Viva, TVOne, Kaltim Post all live-covering

events.event: Jokowi's aide AKBP Syarif Muhammad Fitriansyah is due to testify at the dr Tifa trial on 12 November, per a detik headline.
events.why_it_matters: Next scheduled step in the diploma-related trials.

events.event: The forest-area enforcement task force (Satgas PKH), via spokesperson Barita Simanjuntak, takes over all land affiliated with Arif Kurniawan (AK) over preliminary findings of irregularities in mining governance, licensing and illegal control of forest areas.
events.key_numbers: Takeover effective 4 Nov 2026 · Hectares and fine amounts not stated · Next: inventory, collect administrative fines, recover assets, refer suspected crimes to law enforcement
events.why_it_matters: Shows the state seizing land from a named businessman without a court ruling yet; sizes are still unknown.

events.event: KPK questions ATR/BPN Minister Nusron Wahid about HGB permit handling and regular payments tied to his post, and says it may summon him again, per CNN Indonesia headlines.
events.key_numbers: Details and amounts not read (article fetch blocked)
events.why_it_matters: A sitting minister questioned by KPK; allegation stage only, no suspect status stated.

events.event: An expert quoted by CNN Indonesia says Gibran's SMA-equivalence letter (suket) cancelled by the Supreme Court can be submitted again; the same day Gibran's attendance at a church anniversary event in West Sulawesi draws comment from an analyst.
events.key_numbers: Details not read (article fetch blocked) · MA cassation 742/K/TUN/2026 (known)
events.why_it_matters: Points to a possible route for Gibran after the MA ruling, which would change what happens next.

events.event: Aceh governor Muzakir Manaf (Mualem) meets President Prabowo to discuss the Aceh flag and the endowment fund for former GAM combatants, per CNN Indonesia.
events.why_it_matters: The Aceh flag and ex-combatant funds are long-open items from the 2005 Helsinki peace deal.

events.event: CNN Indonesia reports that the investigation into the former MPR Secretary-General's gratification case is complete and he will soon be tried.
events.why_it_matters: Another senior official heading to Tipikor court.
